items.title: Henry Johnson interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: And he came up to me and he really enjoyed my guitar playing. So we became friends.

ctx.x: I want to ask you a question now about working with Basie. From the standpoint of a guitar player, I want you to tell us how that almost now patented Freddie Green kind of guitar playing helped that incredible Basie rhythm section.

Now see, when I got a chance to work with Basie, Freddie was still around, but Basie wasn’t playing anymore, because he was kind of sick. But by working with the band all the other guys were still there. And Freddie Green came through, I was working in Chicago with Joe. And he came after their show and sat down and listened to us. And he came up to me. I knew who he was, but I didn’t think he knew who I was. And he came up to me and he really enjoyed my guitar playing. So we became friends. And I always asked…

But the style that, when I first saw the Basie band, Freddie’s style was more felt than heard, you know? And when you listened for it you could hear it. Because it was like the pulse of the band.
